title: Weekly Frequency Shared by All Workers' Compensation Referral Programs on One Claim
content:
# Weekly frequency shared on one claim

All Workers' Compensation Referral records under the same claim number share the adjuster's weekly frequency. The visits and program days billed in one Monday-to-Sunday week across those referrals may not exceed the authorized visits per week of the authorization in force, nor the program's maximum visits or program days per week. Only one referral under a claim bills a given date of service; a Functional Capacity Evaluation day replaces any therapy visit that day.

## How the week is counted

- **The week** is the Monday-to-Sunday week that contains the date of service.
- **What is counted** is every visit or program day recorded in that week on any of the worker's referrals carrying the same claim number — not only the referral being scheduled.
- **The two ceilings** are the weekly frequency allowed by the authorization in force and the program's own weekly maximum; the count may exceed neither.

## Points of judgement

**Two programs run on the same claim in one week. Do they each have their own weekly allowance?** No. Their recorded visits and program days are added together for the week, and the total is held to the authorization's weekly frequency and the program's weekly maximum.

**Can two referrals on one claim each bill the same date of service?** No. Only one referral under the claim bills that date.

**A Functional Capacity Evaluation falls on a day a therapy visit was also planned under the same claim.** The evaluation day replaces the therapy visit for that day.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

Under one claim, an authorization in force allows 3 visits a week and the program's weekly maximum is also 3. In the week running Monday to Sunday, a therapy visit was recorded on Monday under one referral and program days on Tuesday and Thursday under a second referral on the same claim. The week's count is 3, which reaches both ceilings; a further visit or program day in that same week under either referral would exceed them.
